title: spec(data): the name-only reference value a refused reader is served has a named schema, and referenceNameVisible says which name it carries
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PrTYh9NTZ1gpojcZYPdiSm)_

Fixes #29579

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`referenceNameVisible` 的说明改为写明下发的名字是 ADR-0079 显示名(`nameField`,否则 `displayNameField`,否则推导的标题字段),并列全五种下发 `Record #` 兜底的情形;下发值 `{ id, name, readRefused: true }` 有了具名 schema,并入展开后 lookup 值的联合;引擎的类型改为从它派生。
- 为什么改:这个值发给读不到目标记录的人,公开文字必须准确说明暴露了什么;旧说明只写 `nameField`、只列了三种兜底,下发形状在 spec 里没有名字。
- 风险与回滚:不改任何行为;联合里原有的开放记录成员本就接受这个值,所以没有值的判定变化。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts`(新 schema 与联合);`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`(说明文字);`packages/objectql/src/engine-reference-name-visible.ts`(类型派生)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-value.test.ts`,预期全绿,含新用例「a reader refused the target of a referenceNameVisible field reads the NAMED name-only value」。
- 需要你做的:批准两个名字后再合并:新导出 `ReferenceNameOnlyValueSchema` / `ReferenceNameOnlyValue`,以及 `readRefused` 作为声明的键(triage 6587041711 要求合并前获维护者批准)。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts`.** New closed `ReferenceNameOnlyValueSchema` (`strictObject`): `id` (a `ReferenceIdValueSchema` record id), `name` (non-empty string), `readRefused: true`. Type `ReferenceNameOnlyValue` is its `z.input` type. `valueSchemaFor(def, 'expanded')` for the reference types is now `ReferenceIdValueSchema | ReferenceNameOnlyValueSchema | z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())`. It is a read form only; the stored form stays `ReferenceIdValueSchema`.
- **`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`.** The `referenceNameVisible` JSDoc and `.describe()`:
  - item 1: the name is the ADR-0079 D4 display name `resolveRecordDisplayName` answers (`nameField`, else `displayNameField`, else the derived title field), no longer "the target object's `nameField` value";
  - item 2: the `Record #` floor cases are now all five that objectql's `servableNameField` serves (field-level security, `maskingRule`, formula hop, an explicit pointer (or its `displayNameField` alias) at a column neither title-typed nor autonumber, no usable field-level answer), plus the ADR-0079 floor every reader gets (no resolvable or no non-empty name);
  - the describe names `ReferenceNameOnlyValueSchema`.
- **`packages/objectql/src/engine-reference-name-visible.ts`.** The hand-written `ReferenceNameOnlyValue` interface is gone; the module imports the type from `@objectstack/spec/data` (the module already imported `@objectstack/spec/data` at run time, so the edge exists). No behaviour change.
- **Regenerated.** `content/docs/references/**` (`field.mdx`, `object.mdx`, `system/migration.mdx` carry the field describe; `field-value.mdx` gains the section; `index.mdx` counts 1604 → 1605), `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, `json-schema.manifest`, `authorable-surface/data.json`, and the strictness-ledger counts.
- **Ledgers.** `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains `data/ReferenceNameOnlyValue` site `id` (the build named it: the `ReferenceIdValueSchema` refine does not project, the same as the `data/ReferenceIdValue` row); `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` 818 → 819 isomorphic pins; `strictness-ledger.test.ts` field-value sites 4 → 5.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` minor. `@objectstack/objectql` carries none: built `dist/` holds 0 hits for the new import comment against 1 for a sibling string (positive control); the type is erased and the module is not re-exported.

## Declarations, measured

- **Clause-②: yes (widening).** The PR adds two exports (`ReferenceNameOnlyValueSchema`, `ReferenceNameOnlyValue`) and three authorable-surface rows, which is a widening of the published surface (precedent `FileRefusedValueSchema`, 02d9f69). No value's parse verdict moves: the expanded reference union already held `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())`, which accepts `{ id, name, readRefused: true }`.
- **Metadata-protocol: added.** The build writes three new rows into the authorable-surface shard `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`: `data/ReferenceNameOnlyValue:id`, `:name`, `:readRefused`. That is the claim's measurement and its stated arm. The value is served, never written: the stored form refuses it (test `bad({ type: 'lookup' }, { id, name, readRefused: true })`).

## Tests

All at head `0d181d41`, against a spec `dist/` rebuilt from this tree.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/field-value.test.ts src/data/field-reference-name-visible.test.ts src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts scripts/strictness-ledger.test.ts` → `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 69 passed (69)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` → exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` → `Test Files 541 passed (541)`, `Tests 10493 passed (10493)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data-reference-name-visible.test.ts` (the served-value end-to-end suite of PR #29576) → `Tests 23 passed (23)`.

<details><summary>Reverse verification: the engine type follows the spec schema</summary>

One-shot, not kept. `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` changed the spec schema's `name: z.string().min(1)` to `name: z.number()` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `e91212ba468a` → `e122c5983b7e`), then rebuilt spec and type-checked objectql:

```text
spec-build-exit 0
objectql-typecheck-exit 2
src/engine-reference-name-visible.ts(147,26): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'.
```

Line 147 is the `served.set(id, { id, name: resolveRecordDisplayName(...), readRefused: true })` call, so the engine reads the type from the rebuilt spec `.d.ts`. Restored (blob hash equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), spec rebuilt, objectql typecheck exit 0, `check:generated` all 14 current.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (the private `serveReferenceNames` docblock, ~L13860) still says the floor is served "when field-level security keeps that field from the caller", one case of five. It is a private method's comment that does not ship (0 hits in objectql `dist/index.d.ts`), and the module header of `engine-reference-name-visible.ts` already lists all of them. Not in this claim's file surface; left as is.

## Verification

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `0d181d41` (19 paths vs merge base `81cd9eb0e`).

- 107 derived, 106 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED. `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 107 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 106 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).`
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package built). Left to CI.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (shallow clone could not read its pinned positive control); after `git fetch origin 621a4876…` it exits 0 (`48 cases pass`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → `✓ All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` (an exported interface left a module) → `OK — 2 anchored file(s) in the change set, 9 anchor(s) judged, 0 lost.`
- `origin/main` at `5bd615eff` merges cleanly (`git merge-tree` exit 0); none of its commits since the base touch this diff's files.
- Families CI runs (lint, `Test Core`, type-check lanes) are CI's run on this PR.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.

## Maintainer approval

Warren approved the new public names `ReferenceNameOnlyValueSchema`, `ReferenceNameOnlyValue` and `readRefused` as named, with `Metadata-protocol: added` kept: 「全部批准」 on the decision card 「六个命名/措辞全部按推荐批准吗？」 in the project thread "Decide pending spec name approvals", 2026-11-03 00:08Z.
